properties.description: Declares subject / object / conduit / witness (or the type's own roles) on each relation-standing node type — Interface, TemporalFact and the rest of the six — and carries the role in the declared reading of each edge or pointer from it, so the conduit PROVIDES ∘ CONSUMES⁻¹ through an Interface is a declared three-party relation.
properties.name: Node types that stand for a relationship declare their participants' roles, and each edge or pointer from them reads as the role it fills
